summary: security lens over quality-gate-baseline (16 product path(s), 982ed20..e5afac7, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 0 non-blocking. The current commands and workflow are appropriately constrained, but the guard's conditional-block heuristic does not match verify.py's effective assignment semantics. A later FACTORY command override can therefore bypass the declared quality command while the guard remains green, violating the central gate contract.
